When a Trello sprint list is fully populated and ready to start, GAIA schedules the sprint kickoff call. When the call ends, GAIA posts the meeting summary to the board and creates Trello cards from action items extracted from the transcript.

This integration is built for agile teams, project managers, and any group that runs structured board reviews on Zoom and needs meeting outcomes to live inside Trello where the actual work is tracked.

useCases.title: Schedule sprint kickoff calls from board stage changes
useCases.description: When a Trello board moves to a new sprint stage or a sprint list is populated, GAIA schedules a Zoom kickoff call with the team, sends calendar invites, and attaches the meeting link to the Trello board.

useCases.title: Post Zoom meeting summaries to Trello cards
useCases.description: After a Zoom call associated with a Trello board, GAIA generates a meeting summary from the transcript and posts it as a comment on the relevant card, creating a permanent discussion record.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from Zoom action items
useCases.description: GAIA analyzes Zoom call transcripts for action items and creates corresponding Trello cards in the appropriate list, with the action item as the card title and the responsible person as the assignee.

useCases.title: Sprint retrospective scheduling
useCases.description: When all cards in a Trello sprint list are completed, GAIA schedules a retrospective Zoom call with the team and attaches a retrospective summary template to the Trello board for preparation.

useCases.title: Card review sessions for blocked items
useCases.description: When multiple Trello cards are flagged as blocked, GAIA schedules a Zoom unblocking session with the relevant card owners and posts a pre-meeting agenda to the board with all blocked cards listed.

howItWorks.step: Connect Trello and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Trello boards and Zoom account. Link your calendar so GAIA can schedule meetings that fit the team's availability.

howItWorks.step: Configure board events that trigger meetings
howItWorks.description: Define which Trello board states or list events should trigger Zoom meetings, who should be invited, and when the meeting should be scheduled relative to the board event.

howItWorks.step: GAIA schedules calls and captures outcomes
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Trello for trigger events, schedules Zoom meetings, and after each call posts summaries and action item cards back to the board automatically.

faqs.question: Can GAIA schedule a Zoom call directly from a Trello card comment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mention GAIA in a Trello card comment asking for a meeting, and GAIA will schedule a Zoom call with the card members, check calendar availability, and post the meeting link back to the card.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Zoom cloud recording for meeting summaries?
faqs.answer: Zoom transcription or cloud recording must be enabled on the meeting for GAIA to generate summaries. GAIA accesses the transcript after the meeting ends and generates a structured summary.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create recurring sprint meetings based on Trello sprint cycles?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can schedule recurring Zoom sprint calls based on your Trello board's sprint cadence, automatically adding the meeting link to the board and updating the invite as team membership changes.

hubspot-notion.tagline: Sync HubSpot CRM data to Notion docs and document deals and customer research
hubspot-notion.metaTitle: HubSpot と Notion の連携: 商談と連絡先を記録
hubspot-notion.metaDescription: HubSpotの商談からNotionページを作成し、連絡先をデータベースに同期、ステージ変更も自動で記録。GAIAが両方を最新に保ちます。設定手順をご覧ください。
hubspot-notion.intro:
HubSpotとNotionの連携は、CRMのレコードをNotionにコピーし、取引メモ、アカウント調査、パイプラインのレポートをチームの他のドキュメントと同じ場所に置けるようにするものです。GAIAを両方のアプリに接続すれば、ルールを一度説明するだけで済みます。HubSpotの新しいコンタクトをNotionのデータベースに追加する、新しい取引ごとにNotionページを作成する、取引ステージの変更をNotionに記録する、といった内容です。GAIAは設定したスケジュール（1時間ごと、毎朝、毎週）でHubSpotを確認し、新規または変更されたレコードをNotionに書き込みます。

方向によって動きが違います。GAIAにはHubSpotのイベントトリガーがないため、HubSpotからNotionへは取引が作成された瞬間ではなくスケジュールで実行され、実行の合間はNotionが1回分遅れることがあります。NotionからHubSpotへはイベントで動かせます。議事録などのNotionデータベースにページが追加されると、GAIAが該当するHubSpotのコンタクトや取引にメモとして記録します。

HubSpotのすべてのプロパティを数分以内にNotionへ反映したい場合は、ZapierやMakeのような専用の自動化ツールの方が向いています。GAIAは、処理の中に判断を入れたいチームに向いています。コンタクトの最近のメールを含む調査ページ、文章でまとめた週次のパイプライン報告、すべてをコピーせずテスト用や重複の取引を除外することなどです。

useCases.title: HubSpotの新しい取引ごとにNotionページを作成
useCases.description: スケジュール実行のたびに、GAIAは前回以降に作成された取引を一覧にし、Notionの取引データベースにページを作成します。取引名、金額、ステージ、クローズ日、関連コンタクトに加え、指定した調査用テンプレートも入れます。

useCases.title: HubSpotの新しいコンタクトをNotionデータベースに追加
useCases.description: GAIAは新しいコンタクトを、氏名、メール、会社、役職、ライフサイクルステージとともにNotionデータベースにコピーします。チームはHubSpotを開かずにNotionでアカウントを調べられます。

useCases.title: HubSpotの取引ステージの変更をNotionに記録
useCases.description: 実行のたびに、GAIAは進行中の各取引のステージをNotionのエントリーと比べます。ステージが変わっていればStageプロパティを更新し、取引ページに日付付きの行を追記するので、Notionにステージの履歴が残ります。

useCases.title: Notionに週次のパイプライン報告を作成
useCases.description: 毎週のスケジュールで、GAIAは進行中の取引を読み取り、ステージ別の取引、合計金額、今月クローズ予定の取引、クローズ日を過ぎた取引をまとめたNotionページを作成します。

useCases.title: Notionの議事録をHubSpotに記録
useCases.description: Notionの議事録データベースにページが追加されると、GAIAはHubSpotで該当するコンタクトや取引を見つけてメモを記録します。CRMのタイムラインが抜けなく保たれます。

howItWorks.step: HubSpotとNotionをGAIAに接続
howItWorks.description: GAIAの連携ページから両方を追加します。Notionでは、Deals、Contacts、AccountsなどGAIAが書き込むデータベースを共有してください。

howItWorks.step: 同期の内容を普段の言葉で説明
howItWorks.description: ワークフローを作成し、何をしてほしいかを書きます。たとえば「1時間ごとに、HubSpotの新しい取引それぞれについてDealsデータベースにページを作成し、金額、ステージ、クローズ日、主担当コンタクトを入れて」や「毎朝、各Notion取引ページのStageプロパティをHubSpotに合わせて更新して」です。どのHubSpotプロパティをどのNotionプロパティに入れるかも書いてください。

howItWorks.step: GAIAがバックグラウンドで実行
howItWorks.description: HubSpotからNotionへのワークフローはスケジュールどおりに実行されます。NotionからHubSpotへのワークフローはNotionページが作成されたときに実行されます。実行のたびに短い報告を受け取ることもでき、いつでも手動で実行を頼めます。

faqs.question: Notionの議事録をHubSpotに戻して同期できますか？
faqs.answer: はい。Notionの議事録データベースにページが追加されると、GAIAが該当するHubSpotの取引やコンタクトにメモとして記録し、CRMのタイムラインを抜けなく保ちます。

faqs.question: Notionページは取引ごとですか、アカウントごとですか？
faqs.answer: どちらでもできます。取引ごとに詳しく追うページにするか、会社ごとにすべての取引とコンタクトをまとめるページにするか、希望する構成を説明してください。

faqs.question: HubSpotのカスタムプロパティをNotionのカスタム項目に同期できますか？
faqs.answer: はい。GAIAはHubSpotのカスタムプロパティを読み書きできます。ワークフローの説明で、どのHubSpotプロパティをどのNotionプロパティに入れるかを指定してください。変更された値は次のスケジュール実行で書き込まれます。

faqs.question: HubSpotで取引が作成された瞬間にNotionも更新されますか？
faqs.answer: いいえ。GAIAにはHubSpotのイベントトリガーがないため、設定したスケジュールでHubSpotを確認します。1時間ごとのワークフローなら、10時10分に作成された取引は11時の実行でNotionに反映されます。すぐに同期するよう頼むこともできます。

faqs.question: NotionからHubSpotにデータを送れますか？
faqs.answer: はい。Notionのトリガーで、ページが作成されたときやプロパティが変わったときにワークフローを開始できます。GAIAはそのページをもとにHubSpotのコンタクト、会社、取引を作成または更新したり、既存のレコードにメモとして記録したりします。

faqs.question: ZapierやMakeでのHubSpotとNotionの自動化とは何が違いますか？
faqs.answer: ZapierやMakeの自動化は、1つのトリガーから決まった項目をコピーします。項目をコピーするだけならそちらの方が簡単です。GAIAは普段の言葉の説明をもとに動くので、読む必要がある作業もこなせます。取引ページにコンタクトの最近のメールの要約を加える、テスト用の取引を飛ばす、週次のパイプライン報告を文章で書く、といったことです。

hubspot-asana.tagline: Create onboarding and delivery tasks in Asana from new HubSpot deals
hubspot-asana.metaTitle: HubSpot と Asana の連携: 成約案件をプロジェクトタスクに
hubspot-asana.metaDescription: HubSpotとAsanaをGAIAで連携。HubSpotの商談が成約するとAsanaのオンボーディングプロジェクトを作成し、商談データをタスクに同期。営業と導入チームの認識を揃えます。
hubspot-asana.intro:
Every closed deal in HubSpot represents a handoff that needs to happen — from sales to customer success, implementation, or delivery. Without automation, that handoff relies on a salesperson remembering to notify the right team, and the delivery team manually creating Asana tasks that should have been generated from the deal data already sitting in HubSpot.

GAIA automates the sales-to-delivery handoff so nothing falls through the cracks. When a HubSpot deal closes, GAIA creates a structured Asana project or task list for the relevant delivery team, pre-populated with customer details from the CRM. As the onboarding progresses, GAIA can log Asana milestone completions back to HubSpot so account managers stay informed without interrupting the delivery team.

This integration is built for SaaS companies, professional services firms, and agencies where closing a deal immediately generates structured delivery work that needs to be tracked in Asana.

useCases.title: Auto-create onboarding projects from closed deals
useCases.description: When a HubSpot deal reaches Closed Won, GAIA creates a new Asana project from the appropriate onboarding template, pre-fills customer details, assigns the customer success team, and sets deadlines based on contract start date.

useCases.title: Sync deal data to Asana project fields
useCases.description: GAIA maps HubSpot deal fields — company name, contract value, product purchased, primary contact — to Asana project custom fields so the delivery team has full context without accessing HubSpot.

useCases.title: Log Asana milestone completions in HubSpot
useCases.description: When key Asana onboarding tasks are completed, GAIA logs the milestones as HubSpot deal activities, keeping account managers informed of onboarding progress directly in their CRM view.

useCases.title: Escalate at-risk onboardings to HubSpot
useCases.description: When an Asana onboarding project is overdue or flagged as at-risk, GAIA creates a HubSpot task for the account owner to reach out to the client proactively, preventing churn before it happens.

useCases.title: Trigger HubSpot sequences from Asana completions
useCases.description: When an Asana onboarding project is marked complete, GAIA enrolls the client in a HubSpot post-onboarding email sequence, initiating the customer success phase without any manual CRM action.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your HubSpot portal and Asana workspace. Map HubSpot pipeline stages and deal properties to Asana project templates and task fields.

howItWorks.step: Define handoff rules and templates
howItWorks.description: Configure which HubSpot deal stages or properties trigger Asana project creation, which Asana template to use for each deal type, and which fields to pre-populate from CRM data.

howItWorks.step: GAIA bridges sales and delivery automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors HubSpot for deal stage changes and creates Asana projects immediately, while also reporting Asana milestone progress back to HubSpot so both teams work from accurate, shared data.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create different Asana templates for different HubSpot deal types?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to select Asana project templates based on HubSpot deal properties such as product line, contract tier, or customer segment, ensuring the right task structure for each engagement.

faqs.question: What happens in Asana if a HubSpot deal is reopened after being closed?
faqs.answer: GAIA can detect deal stage reversals and notify the Asana project team, or optionally pause or archive the Asana project, depending on how your workflow handles deal reversals.

faqs.question: Can sales reps see Asana onboarding progress without an Asana account?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA logs Asana milestone completions as HubSpot activities so account managers see onboarding progress inside HubSpot without needing Asana access.

hubspot-linear.tagline: Link customer feature requests in HubSpot to engineering issues in Linear
hubspot-linear.metaTitle: HubSpot と Linear の連携: 顧客の声を開発につなぐ
hubspot-linear.metaDescription: HubSpotとLinearをGAIAで連携。HubSpotの商談で出た機能要望からLinearの課題を作成し、CRMで要望の状況を追跡。顧客の声から製品提供までの流れを完結させます。
hubspot-linear.intro:
Sales teams capture customer feature requests in HubSpot notes and deal fields, but those requests rarely make it to the engineering team in a structured way. Engineers using Linear have no visibility into which customer asked for a feature or how many deals depend on it. Product decisions get made without the revenue context sitting in HubSpot, and customers wait for features without any feedback loop.

GAIA connects HubSpot and Linear so customer requests drive engineering priorities with full context attached. When a sales rep logs a feature request in HubSpot, GAIA creates or links a Linear issue with the customer details, deal value, and request frequency. When the engineering team ships the feature, GAIA notifies the account owner in HubSpot so they can update the customer before the customer asks.

This integration is essential for product-led and sales-assisted SaaS companies that want feature development to be informed by real customer demand rather than internal guesswork.

useCases.title: Create Linear issues from HubSpot feature requests
useCases.description: When a sales rep logs a feature request on a HubSpot deal or contact, GAIA creates a corresponding Linear issue with the request details, customer name, deal value, and request frequency so engineering has full context.

useCases.title: Track request popularity across deals
useCases.description: GAIA aggregates HubSpot feature request notes across multiple deals and updates a Linear issue's description with a running count of requesting customers and combined deal value, helping engineering prioritize by revenue impact.

useCases.title: Notify account owners when features ship
useCases.description: When a Linear issue linked to a HubSpot feature request is marked Done, GAIA creates a HubSpot task for the account owner to reach out to requesting customers, closing the feedback loop before customers follow up.

useCases.title: Link Linear issues to HubSpot deal records
useCases.description: GAIA adds Linear issue links to HubSpot deal records so account managers can check engineering status on customer-requested features directly from the CRM without needing Linear access.

useCases.title: Escalate high-value feature blockers
useCases.description: When a HubSpot deal is blocked by a missing feature, GAIA escalates the linked Linear issue with a priority flag and deal value annotation, ensuring engineering leadership sees the revenue at stake.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your HubSpot portal and Linear organization. Configure which HubSpot properties indicate a feature request and which Linear team should receive the issues.

howItWorks.step: Define request capture and linking rules
howItWorks.description: Set the HubSpot deal or contact properties that GAIA monitors for feature requests, and configure how GAIA deduplicates requests — creating a new Linear issue or linking to an existing one.

howItWorks.step: GAIA closes the loop between customers and engineering
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors HubSpot for new requests and Linear for issue completions, creating issues, updating request counts, and notifying account owners when requested features are shipped.

faqs.question: Can GAIA deduplicate feature requests from multiple HubSpot deals?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA matches requests by feature name or description and links multiple HubSpot records to a single Linear issue, updating the issue with a count of requesting customers rather than creating duplicates.

faqs.question: Can account managers see Linear issue status from HubSpot?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA adds the Linear issue link and current status to the HubSpot deal or contact record, so account managers can see whether a feature is backlogged, in progress, or shipped without accessing Linear.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support HubSpot custom properties for feature request tracking?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to read feature request data from any HubSpot custom property on deal or contact records, not just standard fields, so it fits your existing CRM data model.

hubspot-google-calendar.tagline: Sync HubSpot sales meetings with Google Calendar activities automatically
hubspot-google-calendar.metaTitle: HubSpot + Google Calendar Automation - Log Sales Meetings to CRM
hubspot-google-calendar.metaDescription: Connect HubSpot and Google Calendar with GAIA. Automatically log calendar meetings as CRM activities, create follow-up tasks from call outcomes, and keep your CRM timeline accurate without manual entry.
hubspot-google-calendar.intro:
Sales and customer success teams live between two critical tools: Google Calendar for scheduling client meetings and HubSpot for managing the CRM records of those same clients. The problem is that these two systems rarely talk to each other. Meetings happen in Google Calendar but are manually logged in HubSpot — or worse, never logged at all. Contact details in HubSpot aren't visible in calendar invites. The result is a CRM that is perpetually behind and a team that wastes time on manual data entry.

GAIA bridges Google Calendar and HubSpot so that client meetings are automatically enriched with CRM data and automatically logged as activities. When you schedule a meeting with a known HubSpot contact, GAIA adds their company, deal stage, and recent activity to the calendar event description so you're prepared. When the meeting ends, GAIA logs it as a HubSpot activity with attendees, duration, and any notes you add, keeping your CRM accurate without any manual entry.

This integration is essential for account executives, SDRs, and customer success managers who need their meeting and CRM records to stay in perfect alignment without the overhead of double data entry.

useCases.title: Enrich calendar invites with HubSpot contact data
useCases.description: When you schedule a Google Calendar event with a HubSpot contact's email, GAIA automatically adds their company, title, deal stage, and last interaction date to the event description so you walk into every meeting prepared.

useCases.title: Auto-log completed meetings to HubSpot
useCases.description: When a Google Calendar event with a HubSpot contact ends, GAIA logs it as a meeting activity in HubSpot with attendees, duration, and the event description, keeping your CRM up to date without manual logging.

useCases.title: Create HubSpot follow-up tasks from meeting outcomes
useCases.description: After a meeting is logged, GAIA automatically creates a HubSpot follow-up task for the rep with a suggested due date so the next step is always captured and the deal keeps moving forward.

useCases.title: Surface HubSpot deal context before meetings
useCases.description: The day before a client meeting, GAIA sends you a briefing with the HubSpot deal status, recent email activity, open tasks, and any notes from previous meetings so you're fully prepared without opening HubSpot.

useCases.title: Sync HubSpot meeting links to calendar invites
useCases.description: When HubSpot Meetings is used to schedule calls, GAIA syncs those bookings to Google Calendar with full event details, ensuring your personal calendar reflects every client-scheduled meeting automatically.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Google Calendar to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize HubSpot portal and Google Calendar in GAIA's settings. GAIA matches calendar attendees to HubSpot contacts by email address to enrich and log events accurately.

howItWorks.step: Configure enrichment, logging, and follow-up rules
howItWorks.description: Set which HubSpot contact and deal fields should appear in calendar event descriptions, which completed event types should be auto-logged to HubSpot, and whether follow-up tasks should be created automatically.

howItWorks.step: GAIA enriches meetings and logs them to HubSpot automatically
howItWorks.description: Before each meeting GAIA enriches the calendar event with CRM context. After the meeting ends, GAIA logs it to HubSpot and creates follow-up tasks, completing the full sales activity loop.

faqs.question: What if a meeting attendee is not in HubSpot?
faqs.answer: GAIA can automatically create a new HubSpot contact when a meeting is logged with an attendee email that doesn't match an existing contact, or it can flag the attendee for manual review depending on your preference.

faqs.question: Can GAIA log internal meetings or only client-facing ones?
faqs.answer: You can configure GAIA to log only meetings with external domains, only meetings where contacts match known HubSpot contacts, or all meetings. Internal-only meetings can be excluded.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support HubSpot deal associations when logging meetings?
faqs.answer: Yes. When logging a meeting, GAIA associates the activity with the relevant HubSpot deal or deals linked to the attendee contacts, so the meeting appears in the deal timeline and not just the contact record.

hubspot-drive.tagline: Attach HubSpot sales proposals and contracts to Google Drive automatically
hubspot-drive.metaTitle: HubSpot と Google Drive の連携: 営業資料を自動保存
hubspot-drive.metaDescription: HubSpotとGoogle DriveをGAIAで連携。HubSpotの提案書、契約書、営業資料をDriveのフォルダに自動保存。すべての営業ドキュメントを整理して管理できます。
hubspot-drive.intro:
Sales teams create proposals, contracts, and other essential documents for deals, but those files typically live in Google Drive while the deal record lives in HubSpot. Without automation, reps spend time searching Drive for the right version of a proposal, or they share the wrong file because the Drive folder structure does not map to HubSpot deal records.

GAIA connects HubSpot and Google Drive so sales documents are always organized and accessible from the CRM. When a new HubSpot deal is created, GAIA creates a structured Drive folder for the account. As documents are created or uploaded to Drive for a deal, GAIA attaches them to the corresponding HubSpot deal record with the correct document type and version. When a contract is executed, GAIA advances the HubSpot deal stage automatically.

This integration is essential for sales teams who generate custom proposals, legal teams managing contracts, and revenue operations teams who need all deal-related documentation organized and accessible from their CRM.

useCases.title: Create Drive folders for HubSpot opportunities
useCases.description: When a HubSpot opportunity is created, GAIA creates a structured Google Drive folder for the account with subfolders for proposals, contracts, and supporting materials. The Drive folder link is attached to the HubSpot deal.

useCases.title: Auto-attach proposals and contracts to HubSpot deals
useCases.description: When a proposal or contract is created in Drive and linked to a HubSpot deal, GAIA automatically attaches it to the deal record in HubSpot, ensuring all deal assets are accessible from the CRM without manual upload.

useCases.title: Notify reps when deal documents are updated
useCases.description: When a proposal or contract in Drive is edited or revised, GAIA posts a comment on the linked HubSpot deal record notifying the account owner, ensuring they always have the latest version.

useCases.title: Advance deal stage when contracts are signed
useCases.description: When a signed contract is uploaded to a deal's Drive folder, GAIA advances the HubSpot deal to Closed Won, records the contract date, and creates the post-sale handoff task automatically.

useCases.title: Advance deal stage when contracts are signed
useCases.description: When a signed contract is added to a deal's Drive folder, GAIA advances the HubSpot deal to Closed Won, records the signed date, and creates the post-sale handoff task, closing the sales cycle automatically.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Google Drive to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your HubSpot portal and Google Drive account. GAIA maps HubSpot deals to their corresponding Google Drive folders.

howItWorks.step: Define folder structure and document attachment rules
howItWorks.description: Specify the Drive folder structure for new deals and the rules GAIA uses to attach documents to HubSpot records — by file name, subfolder location, or document type.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps deal documents organized and CRM-linked
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both HubSpot and Drive for changes, creating folders, attaching files, and advancing deal stages automatically. Sales teams always have the right documents associated with the right deals.

faqs.question: Can GAIA generate proposal drafts from HubSpot deals?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can take a proposal template from Drive, populate it with HubSpot deal data (company, products, pricing), and attach the generated proposal to the HubSpot deal.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support multiple document types per deal?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can attach proposals, contracts, NDAs, and other file types to HubSpot deals based on your configured rules, organizing them into subfolders in Drive and labeling them correctly in HubSpot.

faqs.question: What happens if a file in Drive is moved or renamed?
faqs.answer: Drive links are generally stable, but if a file is moved or renamed, GAIA can detect the change and update the link in the HubSpot record. This requires GAIA to have ongoing access to your Drive.

hubspot-zoom.tagline: Log Zoom sales calls to HubSpot and create follow-up tasks from meeting outcomes
hubspot-zoom.metaTitle: HubSpot と Zoom の連携: 営業通話を CRM に記録
hubspot-zoom.metaDescription: HubSpotとZoomをGAIAで連携。Zoom通話をHubSpotの連絡先や商談に自動記録し、文字起こしからアクションアイテムを抽出。営業の会話をCRMに反映できます。
hubspot-zoom.intro:
Sales reps live in HubSpot and spend their days on Zoom calls, but the connection between the two is broken. Call notes rarely make it into HubSpot, action items get lost, and deal progress slows because crucial conversation context is missing from the CRM.

GAIA bridges HubSpot and Zoom so every sales call automatically logs to the right CRM record. Meeting summaries are generated from transcripts and attached to deals. Action items become HubSpot tasks. Your CRM timeline reflects every interaction, giving your entire team complete visibility into customer relationships without manual data entry after every call.

This integration is built for sales teams that want complete CRM activity timelines, managers who need call visibility without listening to recordings, and account teams who need to hand off deals with full conversation context.

useCases.title: Auto-log Zoom calls to HubSpot CRM
useCases.description: When a Zoom meeting includes a HubSpot contact, GAIA logs the meeting as an activity on the contact and deal record, attaching the summary and recording link. CRM activity is complete without manual effort.

useCases.title: Create HubSpot follow-up tasks from Zoom action items
useCases.description: Action items identified in a Zoom call summary become HubSpot tasks assigned to the account owner. Due dates from the conversation are applied so nothing falls post-call.

useCases.title: Post Zoom call summaries to HubSpot deals
useCases.description: After each Zoom call, GAIA generates a summary from the transcript and posts it to the relevant HubSpot deal record. Account teams have immediate access to call outcomes.

useCases.title: Advance HubSpot deal stage based on call outcomes
useCases.description: If a Zoom call results in a verbal agreement or a request for a contract, GAIA advances the HubSpot deal stage accordingly. Pipeline stages stay current without manual updates.

useCases.title: Manager coaching alerts from call analysis
useCases.description: GAIA monitors Zoom call summaries for coaching opportunities — such as long seller monologues or missed next steps — and creates HubSpot tasks for sales managers to provide feedback.

howItWorks.step: Connect HubSpot and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize HubSpot portal and Zoom account in GAIA. GAIA matches Zoom meeting attendees to HubSpot contacts by email address automatically.

howItWorks.step: Configure logging rules and action item extraction
howItWorks.description: Set which Zoom meetings trigger CRM logging — by attendee domain, calendar, or meeting type — and configure how GAIA extracts action items and summaries from transcripts.

howItWorks.step: GAIA logs every call and drives follow-through
howItWorks.description: After each qualifying Zoom call, GAIA creates the activity, tasks, and any deal stage updates in HubSpot. Your CRM is always current without post-call admin work.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Zoom cloud recording for call summaries?
faqs.answer: Yes. For GAIA to generate call summaries and extract action items, Zoom cloud recording and transcription must be enabled for your meetings.

faqs.question: Can GAIA match Zoom calls to the correct HubSpot deal when a contact has multiple open deals?
faqs.answer: GAIA matches calls to the HubSpot contact first. If multiple deals are associated, it defaults to the most recently updated active deal or prompts the rep to choose.

faqs.question: Can GAIA log internal Zoom calls or only external sales calls?
faqs.answer: You can configure GAIA to log only meetings with external domains matched to HubSpot contacts, excluding internal team meetings. This keeps your CRM activity timeline focused on customer interactions.

salesforce-slack.tagline: Post deal alerts to Slack and update Salesforce records from Slack messages
salesforce-slack.metaTitle: Salesforce と Slack の連携: 案件アラートを即時通知
salesforce-slack.metaDescription: SalesforceとSlackをGAIAで連携。商談ステージの変化をSlackに即通知し、SlackのメッセージからCRMを更新。営業チームは普段使うツールのまま認識を揃えられます。
salesforce-slack.intro:
Revenue teams live in Slack but their deal data lives in Salesforce, and the gap between the two means critical deal events go unnoticed until someone checks the CRM. A deal closes and the broader team finds out hours later. A deal goes cold and no one escalates because the signal was buried in a Salesforce report nobody opened.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Slack so deal intelligence flows into the conversations where decisions are made. Won deals trigger immediate Slack announcements to the revenue channel. At-risk opportunities generate alerts to the account owner. High-value pipeline updates surface in leadership channels. And when a rep needs to update Salesforce quickly, they can do it from Slack without switching tabs.

This integration is essential for high-velocity sales teams where deal momentum depends on real-time information, and for revenue leaders who need pipeline visibility without pulling reports manually.

useCases.title: Celebrate closed deals in Slack instantly
useCases.description: When a Salesforce opportunity is marked Closed Won, GAIA posts a deal win announcement to the revenue Slack channel with the deal name, value, account, and rep, giving the team immediate visibility and morale.

useCases.title: Alert account owners about at-risk deals
useCases.description: When a Salesforce deal's close date passes without progressing or is moved back multiple times, GAIA sends a Slack DM to the account owner and a channel alert to the sales manager to trigger intervention.

useCases.title: Update Salesforce fields from Slack
useCases.description: Reps can message GAIA in Slack to update Salesforce deal fields — close date, stage, next step, amount — without opening Salesforce, reducing CRM friction for field reps and fast-moving deal cycles.

useCases.title: Weekly pipeline digest in Slack
useCases.description: GAIA posts a structured weekly pipeline digest to the revenue Slack channel listing deals by stage, total pipeline value, deals closing this week, and deals that have not been updated in over a week.

useCases.title: New lead alerts for high-priority accounts
useCases.description: When a new Salesforce lead is created for a target account or high-value company, GAIA posts an immediate alert to the designated Slack channel so the right rep can respond before the lead goes cold.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Slack to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Slack workspace. Map Salesforce pipeline stages and record types to Slack channels for notifications.

howItWorks.step: Configure alert rules and channel mappings
howItWorks.description: Define which Salesforce events — stage changes, deal wins, overdue dates, new leads — trigger Slack messages, and specify the target channel or user for each alert type.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps your revenue team informed in real time
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Salesforce for deal events and posts structured notifications to Slack immediately, while also accepting CRM update requests from Slack to keep deal data current.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post Salesforce alerts to different Slack channels for different deal sizes?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to route alerts based on deal value — enterprise deals to a dedicated channel, SMB deals to another — so the right audience sees each notification.

faqs.question: What Salesforce fields can be updated from Slack?
faqs.answer: GAIA supports updating standard Salesforce fields — stage, close date, amount, next step, description — and custom fields via natural language commands in Slack. The update is reflected in Salesforce immediately.

faqs.question: Can GAIA notify the full account team, not just the deal owner?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can notify all Slack users mapped to the Salesforce account team for a given deal, ensuring everyone with a stake in the account is informed of significant events.

salesforce-gmail.tagline: Log emails to Salesforce automatically and create leads from Gmail replies
salesforce-gmail.metaTitle: Salesforce + Gmail Automation - Log Every Email to CRM Automatically
salesforce-gmail.metaDescription: Connect Salesforce and Gmail with GAIA. Automatically log client emails to Salesforce deal and contact records, create leads from inbound email replies, and keep your CRM activity timeline complete without manual entry.
salesforce-gmail.intro:
Sales reps send and receive dozens of client emails every day in Gmail, but those emails rarely make it into Salesforce without a deliberate BCC to the CRM email address or a manual activity log. The result is a Salesforce record that understates contact frequency, misses key conversation threads, and fails to capture the email trail that might be critical for deal reviews or handoffs.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Gmail so every relevant client email is logged to the correct CRM record automatically. When a Gmail message is sent to or received from a Salesforce contact, GAIA logs the email as an activity on the contact and opportunity record. When a promising email reply arrives from an unknown address, GAIA can create a new lead in Salesforce so the prospect enters the pipeline immediately.

This integration is built for sales teams that want complete CRM activity timelines without requiring reps to remember to log emails, and for revenue operations teams who need accurate engagement data for pipeline analysis and forecasting.

useCases.title: Log Gmail emails to Salesforce contact records automatically
useCases.description: When a Gmail email is sent to or received from a Salesforce contact's email address, GAIA logs the email as an activity on the contact record with the subject, timestamp, and direction, keeping the CRM timeline complete.

useCases.title: Create Salesforce leads from inbound email replies
useCases.description: When an inbound Gmail reply arrives from an email address not in Salesforce, GAIA creates a new lead with the sender's name, email, company, and the email content as the lead description, triggering immediate follow-up.

useCases.title: Attach emails to Salesforce opportunity records
useCases.description: GAIA matches Gmail emails to the relevant Salesforce opportunity based on the contact association and logs the email on both the contact and the deal record, giving account teams full deal email history in the CRM.

useCases.title: Identify unresponsive prospects from email gaps
useCases.description: GAIA monitors Gmail activity for Salesforce contacts and alerts the rep when a prospect has not replied to an email in a configurable number of days, prompting follow-up before the deal goes cold.

useCases.title: Draft Salesforce-informed email responses
useCases.description: When a client email arrives, ask GAIA to draft a reply using CRM context — deal stage, last meeting notes, open tasks — so the response is personalized and accurate without the rep switching to Salesforce to look up details.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Gmail to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Gmail account. GAIA matches Gmail sender and recipient addresses to Salesforce contact and lead records automatically.

howItWorks.step: Configure logging rules and lead creation criteria
howItWorks.description: Define which Gmail emails to log — by contact domain, label, or thread — and set the criteria for when an unknown email address should create a new Salesforce lead versus be ignored.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps every client email in your CRM
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Gmail for inbound and outbound messages matching Salesforce contacts and logs them automatically, while also creating leads from high-potential inbound emails so no prospect slips through.

faqs.question: Does GAIA log every email or only emails to Salesforce contacts?
faqs.answer: By default, GAIA logs only emails where the sender or recipient matches a Salesforce contact or lead email address. You can also configure it to log emails from specific domains or Gmail labels.

faqs.question: Can GAIA attach the full email body to Salesforce or just a summary?
faqs.answer: GAIA logs the email subject, timestamp, direction, and a configurable amount of the body text to the Salesforce activity record. Full email bodies can be included if your Salesforce storage limits allow.

faqs.question: What happens when an email involves multiple Salesforce contacts?
faqs.answer: GAIA logs the email to all matching Salesforce contact records in the thread and associates it with the relevant open opportunity for each contact, ensuring no touchpoint is missed on multi-stakeholder deals.

salesforce-notion.tagline: Sync Salesforce deal data to Notion and document account strategies collaboratively
salesforce-notion.metaTitle: Salesforce + Notion Automation - Bring CRM Data into Your Notion Workspace
salesforce-notion.metaDescription: Connect Salesforce and Notion with GAIA. Automatically create Notion deal pages from Salesforce opportunities, sync pipeline data to Notion databases, and keep account strategies aligned with live CRM data.
salesforce-notion.intro:
Enterprise sales teams manage complex deals that require rich documentation — account strategies, stakeholder maps, competitive positioning, executive briefings — that cannot live inside Salesforce's structured fields. Notion is where this content gets written, but it stays disconnected from the live deal data in Salesforce. Account documents go stale, pipeline dashboards in Notion require manual updates, and new team members cannot find the strategic context built up during the deal cycle.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Notion so deal intelligence flows between CRM and knowledge base automatically. When a Salesforce opportunity is created, GAIA creates a Notion deal page from an account strategy template pre-populated with CRM data. As the deal progresses, GAIA updates the Notion page with stage changes and key metrics. When account strategies or meeting notes are added to Notion, GAIA can log key outcomes back to Salesforce.

This integration is designed for enterprise sales teams, strategic account managers, and revenue operations teams that manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals requiring both structured CRM tracking and rich collaborative documentation.

useCases.title: Create Notion deal pages from Salesforce opportunities
useCases.description: When a Salesforce opportunity is created or reaches a qualifying stage, GAIA creates a Notion deal page from an account strategy template, pre-filled with opportunity name, value, stage, contacts, and close date.

useCases.title: Sync pipeline stages and key metrics to Notion databases
useCases.description: GAIA maintains a Notion database of Salesforce opportunities, keeping stage, value, close date, and rep fields synchronized so pipeline dashboards in Notion always reflect live CRM data.

useCases.title: Document stakeholder maps in Notion with Salesforce contact data
useCases.description: GAIA pulls Salesforce contact records associated with an opportunity and populates the stakeholder map section of the Notion deal page, giving the account team a collaborative space to build relationship strategies.

useCases.title: Log Notion meeting notes to Salesforce activities
useCases.description: When a meeting notes section is updated on a Notion deal page, GAIA creates a corresponding activity note on the Salesforce opportunity, keeping the CRM timeline complete without requiring reps to log in two places.

useCases.title: Executive briefing generation
useCases.description: Before a high-value deal review, GAIA compiles a Notion executive briefing page pulling Salesforce deal data, activity history, and risk signals alongside the strategic notes from the Notion deal page.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Notion to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Notion workspace. Map Salesforce opportunity fields to Notion database properties and deal page sections.

howItWorks.step: Configure page templates and sync triggers
howItWorks.description: Define the Notion deal page template, choose which Salesforce pipeline stages trigger page creation or updates, and set which Notion changes should log back to Salesforce as activities.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps strategy and CRM aligned
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Salesforce for deal changes and Notion for document updates, propagating data in both directions so your strategic documentation always reflects live deal reality.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create different Notion templates for different Salesforce deal types?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to select Notion page templates based on Salesforce opportunity type, record type, or product line, ensuring the right strategic framework is applied to each deal.

faqs.question: How often does GAIA sync Salesforce data to the Notion pipeline database?
faqs.answer: GAIA syncs on configurable intervals — real-time on stage changes, or on a scheduled basis for field updates. You can also trigger a manual sync on demand for a specific opportunity.

faqs.question: Can multiple team members collaborate on a Notion deal page while GAIA syncs CRM data?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA writes to specific structured sections of the Notion deal page — CRM-synced fields, activity logs — while leaving collaborative sections free for the account team to edit without conflict.

salesforce-asana.tagline: Create Asana projects from Salesforce opportunities and sync delivery back to CRM
salesforce-asana.metaTitle: Salesforce + Asana Automation - From Closed Deal to Delivery Project
salesforce-asana.metaDescription: Bridge sales and delivery with GAIA. Automatically create Asana projects when Salesforce deals close, sync project milestones back to CRM records, and keep account managers and delivery teams working from shared data.
salesforce-asana.intro:
Closing a deal in Salesforce is only the beginning — the delivery team then needs to execute on the commitments made during the sale. Without automation, the handoff from Salesforce to Asana is manual: someone copies deal details into a new project, assigns tasks by hand, and sets deadlines without referencing the contract dates in Salesforce. The delivery team starts every engagement with incomplete information.

GAIA automates the Salesforce-to-Asana handoff so delivery begins the moment a deal closes. When a Salesforce opportunity reaches Closed Won, GAIA creates a structured Asana project pre-populated with all relevant deal data — company name, scope, contract dates, assigned delivery lead — and assigns tasks based on your delivery playbook. As the project progresses, GAIA reports milestones back to Salesforce so the account team always knows where delivery stands.

This integration is critical for professional services teams, SaaS implementation teams, and any organization where closing a deal immediately creates structured project work that must be tracked in Asana.

useCases.title: Auto-create Asana projects from Salesforce Closed Won deals
useCases.description: When a Salesforce opportunity is marked Closed Won, GAIA immediately creates an Asana project from the appropriate delivery template, pre-fills account details, sets contract-aligned deadlines, and assigns the delivery team.

useCases.title: Sync Salesforce contract data to Asana project fields
useCases.description: GAIA maps Salesforce deal fields — product, contract value, implementation timeline, primary contact — to Asana custom project fields so the delivery team has the sales context they need without CRM access.

useCases.title: Report Asana delivery milestones to Salesforce
useCases.description: When key Asana project milestones are completed, GAIA logs them as Salesforce activity records on the linked account and opportunity, giving account managers delivery status visibility in their CRM.

useCases.title: Alert account managers about at-risk deliveries
useCases.description: When an Asana project is flagged at-risk or falls behind schedule, GAIA creates a Salesforce task for the account owner to proactively communicate with the client and manage expectations.

useCases.title: Generate renewal opportunities from project completion
useCases.description: When an Asana project is marked complete, GAIA creates a new Salesforce opportunity for renewal or expansion, pre-populated with the account details and a renewal timeline based on the original contract.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Asana workspace. Map Salesforce opportunity fields to Asana project templates and define the delivery team assignment rules.

howItWorks.step: Configure handoff triggers and templates
howItWorks.description: Define which Salesforce pipeline stages trigger Asana project creation, which Asana template to use per deal type, and which Asana milestone completions report back to Salesforce.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates the sales-to-delivery handoff
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Salesforce for deal closures and creates Asana projects instantly, while also reporting delivery progress back to Salesforce so account managers stay informed without interrupting the delivery team.

faqs.question: Can GAIA select different Asana templates based on Salesforce deal attributes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Configure GAIA to select Asana templates based on Salesforce fields such as product line, contract size, or customer segment, so the right delivery structure is applied to each type of engagement.

faqs.question: What happens if a Salesforce deal is reopened after the Asana project has started?
faqs.answer: GAIA can detect deal stage reversals and notify the Asana project manager. The Asana project is not automatically deleted — a human decision is needed to pause, cancel, or continue delivery work.

faqs.question: Can account managers in Salesforce see Asana project task-level details?
faqs.answer: GAIA logs milestone-level updates to Salesforce rather than individual task details, keeping the CRM record high-level. Account managers can request a project summary from GAIA at any time for more detail.

salesforce-google-calendar.tagline: Sync sales calls and meetings with Salesforce CRM activities automatically
salesforce-google-calendar.metaTitle: Salesforce + Google Calendar Automation - Log Sales Meetings to CRM
salesforce-google-calendar.metaDescription: Connect Salesforce and Google Calendar with GAIA. Automatically log client meetings as CRM activities, create follow-up tasks from calendar events, and keep your Salesforce activity timeline complete without manual entry.
salesforce-google-calendar.intro:
Account executives and sales reps schedule and attend client meetings in Google Calendar every day, but those meetings only help the team if they are captured in Salesforce. Manual CRM logging is time-consuming and inconsistently done — reps log some meetings, forget others, and rarely capture enough detail for the next person who inherits the account to understand the relationship history.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Google Calendar so every client meeting is automatically recorded in the CRM with zero manual effort from the rep. When a Google Calendar event involves a Salesforce contact, GAIA creates the activity record, attaches meeting notes, and after the meeting generates follow-up tasks based on what was agreed. The Salesforce timeline becomes a complete, accurate record of all client touchpoints without relying on rep discipline.

This integration is essential for enterprise sales teams managing complex deal cycles, customer success managers with large books of business, and revenue operations teams that need accurate activity data for pipeline analysis and forecasting.

useCases.title: Log Google Calendar meetings as Salesforce activities
useCases.description: When a Google Calendar event includes a Salesforce contact's email address, GAIA automatically creates a meeting activity on the Salesforce contact and opportunity record with attendees, date, and duration.

useCases.title: Create Salesforce follow-up tasks after meetings
useCases.description: When a calendar meeting with a Salesforce contact ends, GAIA creates a follow-up task on the opportunity with a configurable due date, prompting the rep to send notes or take the next agreed action.

useCases.title: Attach pre-meeting research to Salesforce records
useCases.description: Before a scheduled meeting with a Salesforce contact, GAIA compiles a meeting brief from CRM data — deal stage, last activities, open tasks — and attaches it to the calendar event so the rep arrives prepared.

useCases.title: Identify deal engagement gaps
useCases.description: GAIA monitors Salesforce opportunities for contacts who have not had a calendar meeting scheduled in a configurable number of days and alerts the rep, ensuring high-value deals maintain appropriate meeting cadence.

useCases.title: Schedule Salesforce-informed follow-up meetings
useCases.description: When a Salesforce task requires a follow-up meeting, GAIA checks the rep's Google Calendar availability and the contact's suggested times to create a meeting invite automatically, reducing scheduling back-and-forth.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Google Calendar to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Google Calendar accounts. GAIA matches calendar attendee email addresses to Salesforce contact and lead records automatically.

howItWorks.step: Configure logging rules and follow-up automation
howItWorks.description: Define which calendar events trigger Salesforce activity creation — by attendee domain, calendar, or event type — and set the follow-up task template that GAIA creates after each meeting.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps your CRM timeline complete
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Google Calendar for client meetings and logs them to Salesforce automatically, creating follow-up tasks and meeting briefs so your CRM accurately reflects every sales interaction.

faqs.question: Does GAIA log internal team meetings to Salesforce or only external client meetings?
faqs.answer: GAIA logs only meetings where attendees match Salesforce contact or lead email addresses by default, excluding internal team meetings from CRM activity logging to keep the timeline relevant.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle calendar meetings where multiple Salesforce contacts attend?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA logs the meeting to all matching Salesforce contact records in the event and associates the activity with the relevant open opportunity for each contact.

faqs.question: What happens when a calendar meeting is cancelled after being logged to Salesforce?
faqs.answer: GAIA updates the Salesforce activity record to reflect the cancellation and can optionally create a reschedule task on the opportunity so the rep follows up to book a new time.

salesforce-drive.tagline: Attach Drive contracts and proposals to Salesforce deals automatically
salesforce-drive.metaTitle: Salesforce と Google Drive の連携: 資料を CRM へ
salesforce-drive.metaDescription: SalesforceとGoogle DriveをGAIAで連携。Salesforceの商談ごとにDriveのフォルダを自動作成し、提案書や契約書を案件に添付。営業資料をCRMから整理して参照できます。
salesforce-drive.intro:
Enterprise sales deals generate extensive documentation — proposals, NDAs, statements of work, contracts, legal amendments — that lives in Google Drive while the deal record lives in Salesforce. Without automation, reps spend time searching for the latest version of a proposal, and document links on Salesforce records go stale when files are moved or renamed in Drive.

GAIA connects Salesforce and Google Drive so deal documentation is always organized and accessible from the CRM. When a Salesforce opportunity is created, GAIA creates a structured Drive folder for the account. As documents are created or signed in Drive, GAIA attaches them to the Salesforce deal record with the correct document type and version. When a contract is executed, GAIA advances the Salesforce deal stage automatically.

This integration is essential for enterprise sales teams managing complex documentation cycles, legal and procurement teams who need audit trails of contract versions, and revenue operations teams who need document accessibility to be automatic rather than reliant on individual rep habits.

useCases.title: Create Drive account folders from Salesforce opportunities
useCases.description: When a Salesforce opportunity is created or reaches a qualifying stage, GAIA creates a structured Google Drive folder for the account with subfolders for proposals, contracts, legal documents, and supporting materials.

useCases.title: Auto-attach Drive documents to Salesforce deal records
useCases.description: When a proposal, contract, or SOW is added to an account's Drive folder, GAIA automatically attaches the file to the linked Salesforce opportunity record with the document type labeled, keeping deal files accessible from the CRM.

useCases.title: Advance deal stage when contracts are signed
useCases.description: When an executed contract is added to the signed documents subfolder in Drive, GAIA advances the Salesforce opportunity to Closed Won, records the contract date, and creates the post-sale handoff task automatically.

useCases.title: Notify reps when documents require action
useCases.description: When a legal team member adds comments or a revised version of a contract to Drive, GAIA creates a Salesforce task for the account executive to review and respond, keeping the contract cycle moving.

useCases.title: Generate proposals from Salesforce data
useCases.description: When a Salesforce opportunity reaches the proposal stage, GAIA creates a Drive proposal document from a template pre-filled with opportunity data — company name, products, pricing, key contacts — saving the rep manual document setup time.

howItWorks.step: Connect Salesforce and Google Drive to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Salesforce organization and Google Drive. Specify the Drive root folder where account folders should be created and the Salesforce pipelines to monitor.

howItWorks.step: Configure folder templates and document rules
howItWorks.description: Define the Drive folder structure for new opportunities and the rules GAIA uses to attach files to Salesforce records — by document type, subfolder location, or file naming convention.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps deal documents organized and CRM-linked
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both Salesforce and Drive for changes, creating folders, attaching documents, advancing deal stages, and notifying reps so your CRM always reflects the current state of your deal documentation.

faqs.question: Can GAIA generate a proposal draft from a Salesforce opportunity on demand?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ask GAIA to generate a proposal for a specific Salesforce opportunity and it will create a Drive document from your template, populate it with opportunity and contact data from Salesforce, and attach it to the deal record.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support multiple document versions on the same Salesforce record?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA attaches each document version to the Salesforce record with a version label and timestamp. Previous versions remain accessible and the latest version is flagged as current.

faqs.question: Can GAIA enforce document naming conventions when creating Drive files?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can define file naming templates that GAIA applies when creating Drive documents from Salesforce data — for example, using opportunity name, account, and date in the file name for consistent organization.

discord-slack.tagline: Bridge your Discord community and Slack work channels automatically
discord-slack.metaTitle: Discord を Slack に接続: コミュニティとチームを連携
discord-slack.metaDescription: Discordのお知らせをSlackに転送し、コミュニティのバグ報告を開発チームへ、リリースノートはDiscordへ。GAIAが転送内容を絞り込みます。設定手順をご覧ください。
discord-slack.intro:
Many teams run their public community on Discord while internal collaboration happens in Slack. Without a bridge, community managers must manually relay feedback, bug reports, and feature requests to engineering and product teams, adding delay and losing context.

GAIA connects Discord and Slack so important community signals flow to the right Slack channels automatically. Announcements posted in Slack can be mirrored to Discord in seconds, and flagged Discord messages can surface directly in Slack threads — keeping both audiences informed without duplicate effort.

useCases.title: Mirror Discord announcements to Slack
useCases.description: When a message is posted in a Discord announcement channel, GAIA forwards it to the designated Slack channel. Internal teams stay informed of community news without monitoring Discord directly.

useCases.title: Escalate community bug reports to Slack engineering
useCases.description: GAIA watches Discord support channels for messages tagged with bug keywords and routes them to your Slack engineering channel with context. Engineers see real user issues without leaving Slack.

useCases.title: Post Slack release notes to Discord
useCases.description: When your team posts a release update in Slack, GAIA formats and publishes it to the appropriate Discord channel so your community is always first to hear about new features.

useCases.title: Sync community feedback to Slack product channel
useCases.description: GAIA collects Discord reactions and feedback threads above a threshold and posts a daily digest to your Slack product channel. Product managers get a clear picture of community sentiment without context switching.

howItWorks.step: Connect Discord and Slack to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Discord server and Slack workspace. Select which Discord channels and Slack channels should be linked.

howItWorks.step: Configure routing rules
howItWorks.description: Define which Discord events — announcements, flagged messages, keywords — should post to which Slack channels. Set formatting preferences so messages appear naturally in each platform.

howItWorks.step: GAIA bridges your platforms automatically
howItWorks.description: Once configured, GAIA monitors both platforms and routes messages according to your rules. Your community and internal teams stay synchronized without any manual forwarding.

faqs.question: Can GAIA sync messages in both directions between Discord and Slack?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA supports bidirectional routing — Discord to Slack and Slack to Discord. You configure which channels and event types trigger each direction independently.

faqs.question: Will GAIA expose internal Slack messages to the Discord community?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA only posts to Discord when you explicitly configure a rule for that direction. Internal-only Slack channels are never exposed unless you set up a rule to share them.

faqs.question: Can I filter which Discord messages get forwarded?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can filter by keyword, channel, role, reaction count, or message type so only relevant signals reach your Slack team. Noise from casual community chat is excluded by default.

discord-google-calendar.tagline: DiscordからGoogleカレンダーに予定を追加し、リマインダーをDiscordのDMで受け取る
discord-google-calendar.metaTitle: DiscordとGoogleカレンダーを連携する3つの方法
discord-google-calendar.metaDescription: DiscordにはGoogleカレンダーとの標準連携がありません。イベントBot、Webhook、そして予定を登録しDiscordのDMでリマインドするGAIAを比較します。
discord-google-calendar.intro:
DiscordにはGoogleカレンダーとの標準連携がなく、どちらのアプリにも両者をつなぐ設定はありません。DiscordとGoogleカレンダーをつなぐ方法は3つです。サーバー内でイベントを投稿・管理するコミュニティ向けイベントBot、Googleカレンダーの予定をWebhook経由でDiscordのチャンネルに送るZapierやMakeなどの自動化ツール、そしてDiscordの中から自分のカレンダーを操作できるGAIAのようなパーソナルアシスタントです。どれが合うかは、そのカレンダーがコミュニティのものか自分のものかで決まります。

サーバー全体のイベントなら：Discordのスケジュールイベント（チャンネル一覧の上にあるイベント欄）では、メンバーが「興味あり」を押すと開始時に通知を受け取れます。SeshやApolloなどのイベントBotは参加表明やリマインダー投稿をチャンネルに追加し、SeshはGoogleカレンダーとの同期も提供しています。共有Googleカレンダーの各予定の前にチャンネルへリマインダーを投稿したいなら、予定の開始前に起動してDiscordチャンネルのWebhookに投稿する自動化がもっとも直接的です。

GAIAが担うのは個人の側です。GAIAにはDiscord Botがあります。GAIAアカウントを連携し、BotにDMを送るかサーバーのチャンネルで@メンションすれば、あなたのGoogleカレンダーを操作します。金曜20時（UTC）のゲームナイトを追加する、土曜が空いているか確認する、セッションを移動する、といった依頼に、依頼した場所で返信します。Discordを優先チャットプラットフォームに設定していれば、リマインダーや定期ブリーフィングはDiscordのDMで届きます。GAIAはサーバーのチャンネルやイベント欄を読まず、サーバーのチャンネルに定期的な告知を投稿することもないため、イベントBotの代わりにはなりません。

useCases.title: DiscordからGoogleカレンダーに予定を追加
useCases.description: GAIAにDMするか@メンションして詳細を伝えます。例：「木曜18時〜20時（CET）の勉強会をカレンダーに追加して」。GAIAがGoogleカレンダーに予定を作成し、同じ会話で確認します。

useCases.title: イベントのリマインダーをDiscordのDMで受け取る
useCases.description: 「レイドの1時間前に知らせて」のようにイベント前のリマインドを頼めます。定期的な予定なら毎週のリマインドも可能です。Discordを優先チャットプラットフォームにしていれば、GAIA BotからDMで届きます。

useCases.title: Discordを離れずに予定を確認
useCases.description: 「明日の予定は？」「土曜の夜は空いてる？」と聞けば、GAIAがGoogleカレンダーを読んでDiscordで答えます。

useCases.title: 毎日のアジェンダをDiscordのDMで
useCases.description: 毎朝その日の予定と受信トレイの急ぎの用件をDiscordのDMで送る定期ワークフローを作成できます。

howItWorks.step: GoogleカレンダーをGAIAに接続
howItWorks.description: GAIAにサインインし、連携ページからGoogleカレンダーを接続します。

howItWorks.step: Discordアカウントを連携
howItWorks.description: DiscordでGAIA Botにメッセージを送ります。初回はDiscordアカウントをGAIAに連携するためのリンクが届きます。リマインダーやブリーフィングをDiscordで受け取りたい場合は、Discordを優先チャットプラットフォームに設定してください。

howItWorks.step: DMか@メンションでGAIAに依頼
howItWorks.description: 予定の登録、確認、リマインドしてほしいことをGAIAに伝えます。定期的なリマインダーや朝のアジェンダは、リマインダーや定期ワークフローの作成を頼んでください。

faqs.question: コミュニティのメンバーはDiscordから直接Googleカレンダーに予定を追加できますか？
faqs.answer: 自分のGAIAアカウントを連携したメンバーなら、GAIAにDMするか@メンションして自分のGoogleカレンダーに予定を追加できます。GAIAがサーバーの投稿をもとに他の人のカレンダーへ予定を追加することはありません。サーバー全体で予定を簡単に保存できるようにするには、Discordのスケジュールイベントか、SeshなどのイベントBotを使ってください。

faqs.question: GAIAはリマインダーにどのタイムゾーンを使いますか？
faqs.answer: GAIAは予定やリマインダーを作成するとき、GAIAアカウントのタイムゾーンを使います。Discordの投稿が別のタイムゾーンで時刻を書いている場合は、「20時UTC」のようにメッセージに含めれば、GAIAが変換します。

faqs.question: GAIAはDiscordの定期イベントに対応できますか？
faqs.answer: GAIAは毎週のゲームナイトのような定期的な予定をGoogleカレンダーに作成し、その前に毎回DiscordのDMでリマインドを送るよう設定できます。Discord自体のスケジュールイベントは、定期かどうかにかかわらず読み取りません。

faqs.question: コミュニティイベントのリマインダーをDiscordで自動送信するには？
faqs.answer: 開始時の通知で十分なら、Discordのスケジュールイベントを使いましょう。「興味あり」を押したメンバーに開始時に通知が届きます。事前にチャンネルへリマインダーを投稿したいなら、SeshやApolloなどのイベントBotか、Googleカレンダーの各予定の前に起動してDiscordのWebhook経由でチャンネルに投稿する自動化ツール（ZapierやMake）を使います。GAIAのリマインダーが届くのはあなた自身のDMで、サーバーのチャンネルではありません。

faqs.question: Discordにカレンダーはありますか？
faqs.answer: Discordにはサーバーのチャンネル一覧の上にあるイベント欄にスケジュールイベントがありますが、カレンダー表示やGoogleカレンダーとの標準同期はありません。そこで作成したイベントは、Botや自動化でコピーしない限りDiscordの中にとどまります。

faqs.question: GAIAはDiscordサーバーのメッセージやイベントを読めますか？
faqs.answer: 読めません。GAIAが見るのは自分宛てのメッセージだけです。つまりBotへのDMと、チャンネルでGAIAを@メンションしたメッセージです。それ以外のチャンネルのメッセージやサーバーのイベント欄は読みません。

discord-todoist.tagline: Create Todoist tasks from Discord messages without leaving the conversation
discord-todoist.metaTitle: Discord と Todoist の連携: チャットからタスクを登録
discord-todoist.metaDescription: チャットのToDoを逃しません。GAIAがリアクションひとつでDiscordのメッセージをTodoistの適切なプロジェクトに保存します。設定手順をご覧ください。
discord-todoist.intro:
Action items surface constantly in Discord conversations — a feature request in the feedback channel, a bug flagged in support, a task someone volunteers for in a thread. Without a way to capture these, they get buried under new messages and forgotten.

GAIA lets anyone on your Discord server create a Todoist task with a simple command or reaction. Tasks are added to the right project with assignee and due date already set, so nothing falls through the cracks and Todoist stays the single source of truth for what needs to get done.

useCases.title: Capture action items from Discord with a reaction
useCases.description: When a team member reacts to a Discord message with a designated emoji, GAIA creates a Todoist task from that message. The task includes a link back to the Discord message for full context.

useCases.title: Create tasks via Discord slash command
useCases.description: Team members type a GAIA command in any Discord channel to create a Todoist task on the spot. They can specify the project, due date, and assignee without ever leaving Discord.

useCases.title: Route channel-specific messages to Todoist projects
useCases.description: Messages in your Discord bug-report or feature-request channels are automatically converted into Todoist tasks in the corresponding project. Triage happens without manual data entry.

useCases.title: Post Todoist task completions back to Discord
useCases.description: When a Todoist task is completed, GAIA posts a brief update to the originating Discord channel. The team sees progress in context without checking Todoist separately.

howItWorks.step: Connect Discord and Todoist to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Discord server and your Todoist account. Map Discord channels to Todoist projects so tasks land in the right place.

howItWorks.step: Choose capture triggers
howItWorks.description: Select whether tasks are created by emoji reactions, slash commands, or automatic channel rules. Configure default assignees and due-date conventions for each channel.

howItWorks.step: GAIA captures and tracks tasks automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors Discord for your configured triggers and creates Todoist tasks instantly. Completions flow back to Discord so the whole team stays informed.

faqs.question: Do Discord members need a Todoist account to create tasks?
faqs.answer: No. Discord members trigger task creation through GAIA's Discord bot. Only the GAIA account connected to Todoist needs a valid Todoist login.

faqs.question: Can I assign tasks to specific Todoist projects based on the Discord channel?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's channel-to-project mapping lets you route tasks from different Discord channels into separate Todoist projects automatically. You configure the mapping once in GAIA's settings.

faqs.question: Will GAIA create duplicate tasks if the same message is reacted to twice?
faqs.answer: GAIA deduplicates by tracking which messages have already generated tasks. If a task already exists for a message, subsequent reactions are ignored rather than creating a duplicate.

discord-trello.tagline: Track community projects on Trello straight from Discord channels
discord-trello.metaTitle: Trello Discord 連携: メッセージからカード作成
discord-trello.metaDescription: コミュニティの声をそのままボードへ。GAIAがDiscordのメッセージからTrelloカードを作成し、更新をチャンネルに返します。設定手順をご覧ください。
discord-trello.intro:
Open-source communities and creator teams often coordinate on Discord but track work on Trello. The gap between them means cards get created late, assignees miss updates, and contributors don't know what's been completed until they check the board manually.

GAIA bridges Discord and Trello so community members can create and update Trello cards directly from Discord, and Trello activity posts back to the relevant Discord channel. Your community's kanban board stays current without anyone having to leave the conversation.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from Discord messages
useCases.description: A reaction or slash command in Discord triggers GAIA to create a Trello card with the message content, assigned list, and due date. Contributors can submit work items without opening Trello.

useCases.title: Post Trello card updates to Discord
useCases.description: When a card moves to 'Done' or a comment is added in Trello, GAIA posts an update to the linked Discord channel. The team celebrates wins and stays aware of progress in real time.

useCases.title: Sync Discord feature requests to a Trello backlog
useCases.description: Feature requests posted in your Discord feedback channel are automatically added as Trello cards in the product backlog. Nothing is lost in chat history and prioritization can happen directly on the board.

useCases.title: Daily Trello board digest in Discord
useCases.description: Each morning, GAIA posts a summary of overdue and due-today Trello cards to your Discord project channel. Contributors know their priorities without a standup or manual board review.

howItWorks.step: Connect Discord and Trello to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Discord server and your Trello workspace. Link specific Discord channels to Trello boards and lists.

howItWorks.step: Configure card creation and notification rules
howItWorks.description: Choose which Discord triggers create Trello cards and which Trello events post back to Discord. Set default labels, lists, and assignees for each channel mapping.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps Discord and Trello in sync
howItWorks.description: GAIA handles card creation and status updates automatically. Your community gets real-time project visibility without switching between Discord and Trello.

faqs.question: Can Discord community members who don't have Trello accounts create cards?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA's Discord bot acts as the Trello account for card creation. Community members only interact with GAIA through Discord reactions or commands.

faqs.question: Which Trello list does GAIA add new cards to?
faqs.answer: You configure the default list per Discord channel in GAIA's settings. You can also allow users to specify a list in the Discord command at creation time.

faqs.question: Can I limit which Discord channels can create Trello cards?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA only listens for card-creation triggers in the channels you explicitly configure. Other Discord channels are ignored, preventing accidental card creation from casual conversation.

discord-jira.tagline: Surface Jira issue updates in Discord engineering channels automatically
discord-jira.metaTitle: Jira と Discord の連携: 課題通知と課題作成
discord-jira.metaDescription: Jiraの状況をDiscordで共有。GAIAが重大なバグや状態変更をチャンネルに投稿し、メッセージから課題を作成します。設定手順をご覧ください。
discord-jira.intro:
Engineering teams that collaborate on Discord still rely on Jira for issue tracking, but context gets siloed between the two. Developers miss status changes because they're heads-down in Discord, while Jira comments go unnoticed by contributors who don't have Jira notifications configured.

GAIA bridges Discord and Jira so engineers stay informed in their primary channel. Jira issue transitions, new assignments, and sprint updates post to the right Discord channels automatically, and team members can create Jira issues directly from Discord without switching tools.

useCases.title: Post Jira issue status changes to Discord
useCases.description: When a Jira issue transitions — from 'In Progress' to 'In Review', for example — GAIA posts an update to the linked Discord channel. Engineers see real-time sprint progress without checking Jira constantly.

useCases.title: Create Jira issues from Discord messages
useCases.description: A slash command or emoji reaction in Discord lets contributors file a Jira issue instantly. GAIA pre-fills the summary, description, and project from the message context.

useCases.title: Alert Discord when a Jira bug is set to Critical
useCases.description: GAIA monitors Jira for priority escalations and posts an immediate alert to your Discord engineering channel when a ticket is marked Critical or Blocker. The right engineers are notified without delay.

useCases.title: Daily Jira sprint digest in Discord
useCases.description: Each morning GAIA posts a summary of open sprint issues, blockers, and items completed yesterday to your Discord standup channel. Teams get sprint visibility without a dedicated standup meeting.

howItWorks.step: Connect Discord and Jira to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Discord server and your Jira project. Map Discord channels to Jira projects so updates and alerts land in the right place.

howItWorks.step: Configure notification and creation rules
howItWorks.description: Select which Jira events — status changes, priority escalations, new assignments — trigger Discord posts. Define which Discord channels can create Jira issues.

howItWorks.step: GAIA keeps Discord and Jira synchronized
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors both platforms and routes information according to your rules. Engineers stay informed in Discord while Jira remains the authoritative issue tracker.

faqs.question: Do contributors need a Jira account to create issues from Discord?
faqs.answer: Creating issues via GAIA requires the GAIA account to have Jira write access. Contributors trigger creation through Discord, but the issue is filed under GAIA's connected Jira identity.

faqs.question: Can GAIA notify different Discord channels for different Jira projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can map each Jira project to a separate Discord channel in GAIA's settings. Issues from the mobile project post to the mobile channel, backend issues to the backend channel, and so on.

faqs.question: Will GAIA spam Discord with every minor Jira comment?
faqs.answer: No. You control which Jira event types trigger Discord notifications. By default, GAIA only posts status transitions and priority changes — not every comment — to keep signal high.

zoom-asana.tagline: Turn Zoom meeting action items into Asana tasks automatically
zoom-asana.metaTitle: Zoom + Asana Automation - Meeting Action Items to Tasks
zoom-asana.metaDescription: Connect Zoom and Asana with GAIA. Auto-create Asana tasks from Zoom meeting summaries, assign owners, set due dates, and ensure every action item gets tracked.
zoom-asana.intro:
Zoom meetings generate action items, but those action items are only as useful as the system that captures them. Without an automatic bridge, someone must manually review the recording or notes and create tasks in Asana — a step that gets skipped when everyone is busy.

GAIA listens to Zoom meeting summaries and transcripts, identifies action items, and creates Asana tasks with the right assignees and due dates before the call is even over. Your team leaves every meeting with a clear, tracked to-do list.

useCases.title: Auto-create Asana tasks from meeting action items
useCases.description: After a Zoom call ends, GAIA parses the meeting summary for action items and creates an Asana task for each one. Assignees and due dates from the conversation are applied automatically.

useCases.title: Link Zoom recording to the Asana project
useCases.description: GAIA attaches the Zoom recording URL to the relevant Asana project as a task or note. Team members can reference the recording directly from the Asana board without hunting through email.

useCases.title: Post meeting summary to Asana project updates
useCases.description: GAIA posts a formatted meeting summary — attendees, decisions, action items — as an Asana project status update so stakeholders who weren't on the call are immediately informed.

useCases.title: Create recurring tasks from recurring Zoom standups
useCases.description: For regular Zoom standups, GAIA generates recurring Asana tasks each session based on blockers and commitments raised. Sprint tracking stays current without manual entry after each meeting.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and Asana to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and Asana workspace. Link specific recurring Zoom meetings to the Asana projects they relate to.

howItWorks.step: Configure task creation preferences
howItWorks.description: Set which sections action items land in, how due dates are inferred, and whether GAIA should tag assignees based on who was mentioned in the meeting.

howItWorks.step: GAIA converts meetings into trackable tasks
howItWorks.description: After each Zoom call, GAIA processes the summary and populates Asana automatically. Your team leaves meetings knowing every commitment is already captured.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Zoom AI Companion or a specific Zoom plan?
faqs.answer: GAIA works with Zoom's meeting summary and transcript features, which are available on Zoom Business and above. If your plan doesn't include summaries, GAIA can use the raw transcript instead.

faqs.question: How does GAIA determine who to assign tasks to in Asana?
faqs.answer: GAIA matches names mentioned in the meeting summary or transcript to Asana members in the linked workspace. You can review and adjust assignments before they are finalized.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle meetings with multiple Asana projects?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can map a single Zoom meeting to multiple Asana projects, and GAIA will route action items to the correct project based on labels or keywords in the meeting notes.

zoom-linear.tagline: Post Zoom sprint summaries to Linear issues and keep engineering on track
zoom-linear.metaTitle: Zoom + Linear Automation - Sprint Meeting Summaries to Issues
zoom-linear.metaDescription: Connect Zoom and Linear with GAIA. Auto-post sprint meeting summaries to Linear, create issues from action items, and keep your engineering cycle updated after every call.
zoom-linear.intro:
Engineering sprint meetings happen in Zoom, but the decisions and commitments made there need to live in Linear where the actual work is tracked. When that bridge is manual, sprint issues go un-updated, blockers stay undocumented, and the Linear board drifts from reality.

GAIA connects Zoom and Linear so sprint summaries are automatically posted to the relevant Linear cycle, and action items become Linear issues with proper assignees and priority. Your Linear board stays accurate after every sprint ceremony without anyone doing data entry.

useCases.title: Post sprint retrospective notes to Linear cycle
useCases.description: After a Zoom retro, GAIA formats the discussion into a structured update and posts it to the active Linear cycle. The team has a searchable record of every retro without manual documentation.

useCases.title: Create Linear issues from Zoom standup blockers
useCases.description: Blockers raised during a Zoom standup are automatically converted into Linear issues by GAIA. Each issue is assigned to the person who raised the blocker and linked to the current sprint.

useCases.title: Update Linear issue status from Zoom planning decisions
useCases.description: When a Zoom planning call moves issues between sprints or changes priorities, GAIA applies those decisions in Linear automatically. The board reflects planning outcomes instantly.

useCases.title: Attach Zoom recording links to Linear project updates
useCases.description: GAIA adds the Zoom recording URL to the relevant Linear project as a comment so engineers can replay any part of the planning or retro discussion directly from their issue tracker.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and Linear to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and Linear workspace. Map recurring Zoom sprint meetings to the corresponding Linear teams and cycles.

howItWorks.step: Define what gets created or updated in Linear
